xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4263: Review verdicts and merges fail on PR lookup: rate-limit errors read as 'no PR', and a closed PR on the same branch wins over the open one

plan.title: Review verdicts and merges fail on PR lookup: rate-limit errors read as 'no PR', and a closed PR on the same branch wins over the open one
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: specialists done calls discoverArtifact, whose gh path runs `gh pr view <branch> ... 2>/dev/null || true`, so a GraphQL rate limit reads as 'no PR' and approved review verdicts (PAN-4222, PAN-3634) were refused and never retried. Separately, PAN-3668's merge was refused because merge-ops.ts prefers the persisted merge_set_repos.artifact_url (#3670, the first, closed PR) over the freshly resolved open PR (#4251). The App-path prs[0] the issue names is a real but dormant bug (no production caller passes repository); the merge gate's lookupPullRequestForBranch has the same prs[0]/--limit 1 shape.
narratives.Proposal: Split failure from absence in the gh and glab lookups; make discoverArtifact return only the open artifact via a shared open-first selector that the merge gate's branch lookup also uses; retry transient forge failures in discoverArtifact (2 s, 8 s); make the merge path land the freshly resolved PR and overwrite a stale stored URL; make specialists done report forge failures honestly and journal a review.verdict-deferred entry that deacon-lite replays through the same CLI door under the original caller, with supersession and a 7-attempt cap; document it in docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Deferral or replay for test and uat verdicts (they get the honest error and exit 1)
- Changing ensurePRExists' swallowed gh pr list error in merge-ops.ts
- Switching the gh path to gh api REST or adding GraphQL quota awareness
- Refreshing or migrating stale merge_set_repos.artifact_url rows outside the merge path
- Retrying createReviewArtifact, mergeReviewArtifact, commentOnArtifact or approveReviewArtifact
- Changing merged-pr-verification.ts or merge-verification.ts
- Weakening reviewVerdictRefusal or verdictCallerFromEnv
- Adding a new pan CLI flag

autoDecisions.summary: Fix PAN-3668's merge at merge-ops.ts (stale stored artifact_url wins) rather than only the forge App path the issue names
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified in overdeck.db that merge_set_repos.artifact_url for PAN-3668 is #3670 and that no production caller passes repository to discoverArtifact, so the App path is unreachable; the issue's requirement (merge lands the PR the gate evaluated) is unambiguous, only its named mechanism was wrong. The App-path prs[0] is still fixed as a latent bug.

autoDecisions.summary: discoverArtifact returns only an OPEN artifact on every path
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says closed/merged PRs are for findMergedArtifact callers only; the gh path previously returned closed PRs when no open one existed, which also stopped pan done from opening a fresh PR.

autoDecisions.summary: Also fix the merge gate's lookupPullRequestForBranch prs[0]/--limit 1
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires the merge to resolve the same PR the gate evaluated; the gate has the same newest-created-wins shape, so both sides must share one selector.

autoDecisions.summary: Include GitLab glab lookup in the failure/absence split
autoDecisions.rationale: getExistingGitLabArtifact has the identical 2>/dev/null || true swallow; glab mr list already returns open MRs only, so the change has no semantic side effect and protects MYN's GitLab repo.

autoDecisions.summary: Deferred verdicts are journaled as review.verdict-deferred and replayed by deacon-lite by spawning the same pan admin specialists done command under the original caller
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps one verdict door (full guard chain, journal, feedback delivery) with no new CLI flag; the journal-tail age is a restart-safe cooldown; 7 attempts at >=10-minute spacing cover GitHub's hourly GraphQL reset.

autoDecisions.summary: Retry policy: 3 attempts, delays 2 s then 8 s, transient errors only
autoDecisions.rationale: Short enough to keep specialists done responsive; the replay handles longer outages such as an exhausted hourly quota.

items.title: gh/glab artifact lookup throws on failure and returns null only on true absence

metadata.acJustification: Six criteria: the five lookup outcomes the PRD lists plus the exec-timeout message the transient classifier depends on; each is one test case in forge.test.ts.

narrative.Action: PRD work item 1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4263.md). In src/lib/forge.ts getExistingGitHubArtifact gh branch: remove `2>/dev/null || true`, request `--json url,number,state`, add timeout FORGE_OBSERVATION_TIMEOUT_MS, catch the exec error and return null only when err.stderr matches /no pull requests found for branch/i, when err.killed (exec timeout, empty stderr) throw `gh pr view <branch> timed out after <ms>ms` so the transient classifier matches it, otherwise throw `gh pr view <branch> failed: <stderr>`; return null unless state === 'OPEN' (decision D1/D2). getExistingGitLabArtifact: same removal and timeout, throw `glab mr list failed: <stderr>` on failure (`glab mr list timed out after <ms>ms` when killed), `[]`/empty stays null (D13). githubForgeAdapter.createReviewArtifact: wrap the post-create lookup in try/catch and fall back to parseArtifactRef(url)?.number for id (D5). Add the five tests listed in the PRD to tests/unit/lib/forge.test.ts (its execMock rejects with {stderr}).

items.title: Given gh pr view exits 1 with stderr 'GraphQL: API rate limit already exceeded', when the GitHub adapter looks up the branch, then it rejects with an error whose message contains 'rate limit' instead of returning null
Given gh pr view exits 1 with stderr 'no pull requests found for branch "feature/x"', when the adapter looks up the branch, then it returns null
Given gh pr view returns {state:'CLOSED'} for the branch, when the adapter looks up the branch, then it returns null
Given glab mr list exits non-zero with stderr '401 Unauthorized', when the GitLab adapter looks up the branch, then it rejects with an error containing '401'
Given gh pr create succeeds and the follow-up lookup throws, when createReviewArtifact completes, then the result id equals the PR number parsed from the created URL
Given the gh exec is killed by the timeout with empty stderr, when the adapter looks up the branch, then it rejects with a message containing 'timed out'
Add selectPullRequestForHead and use it on the forge App path

narrative.Action: PRD work item 2. Add `updatedAt: string | null` to GitHubPullRequestForHead and map `updated_at` in listPullRequestsForHead (src/lib/github-app.ts). Export pure `selectPullRequestForHead(prs, { includeClosed })`: open PRs first ordered by updatedAt desc; when includeClosed, then merged ordered by mergedAt desc, then closed ordered by updatedAt desc; null when nothing qualifies. Replace `prs[0]` in forge.ts getExistingGitHubArtifact App path with `selectPullRequestForHead(prs, { includeClosed: false })`.

items.title: Given a closed PR #3670 listed before an open PR #4251, when selectPullRequestForHead runs with includeClosed false, then it returns #4251
Given two open PRs, when the selector runs, then it returns the one with the newer updatedAt
Given only a merged PR and includeClosed false, when the selector runs, then it returns null; with includeClosed true it returns the merged PR ahead of a closed one
Given the GitHub App is configured and repository is passed with [closed #3670, open #4251], when discoverArtifact runs, then it returns id '4251'
Retry transient forge failures in discoverArtifact with backoff

narrative.Action: PRD work item 3 and decisions D3/D4. Create src/lib/forge-transient.ts exporting isTransientForgeError(err: unknown) (matches message plus stderr against /rate limit|secondary rate|abuse detection|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|ENOTFOUND|EAI_AGAIN|ECONNREFUSED|socket hang up|timed out|(?:failed: |HTTP )50[234]\b/i — the status-code alternative is anchored so a PR number like /pull/504 never matches) and retryTransientForgeOp(op, delaysMs = [2000, 8000]) which retries only transient errors, sleeping via setTimeout promises. Wrap both adapters' discoverArtifact methods in retryTransientForgeOp. Tests MUST use vi.useFakeTimers() + vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync() (repo rule: fake timers for retry tests).

items.title: Given one transient failure then success, when retryTransientForgeOp runs under fake timers, then it resolves after 2000 ms of advanced time
Given three transient failures, when retryTransientForgeOp runs, then it rejects with the last error only after 10000 ms of advanced fake time
Given a non-transient error such as 'HTTP 404', when retryTransientForgeOp runs, then it rejects immediately and calls the operation once
Given the message 'no pull requests found for branch', when isTransientForgeError classifies it, then it returns false; given 'API rate limit exceeded' it returns true
Given 'GitHub API GET /x failed: 503 upstream' or 'HTTP 502: Bad Gateway', isTransientForgeError returns true; given 'unrecognized artifact URL https://github.com/o/r/pull/504' it returns false
Merge gate branch lookup ranks the open PR first on both paths

narrative.Action: PRD work item 4. In src/lib/github-pr-lookup.ts lookupPullRequestForBranch: App path uses selectPullRequestForHead(prs, { includeClosed: true }) instead of prs[0]; gh path changes `--limit 1` to `--limit 20`, requests `number,state,mergedAt,updatedAt`, maps rows to GitHubPullRequestForHead (state OPEN→'open' else 'closed', merged = state === 'MERGED') and applies the same selector. Return shape (number, state 'OPEN'|'MERGED'|'CLOSED', mergedAt) is unchanged.

Given gh pr list returns the closed PR first and the open PR second, when lookupPullRequestForBranch runs, then it returns number 4251

narrative.Action: PRD work item 5 and decision D6. This is the ACTUAL PAN-3668 cause (stored merge_set_repos.artifact_url = #3670). In merge-ops.ts replace `const artifactUrl = primaryRepo?.artifactUrl || prResult.prUrl;` (monorepo) and `const artifactUrl = remotePrimaryRepo?.artifactUrl || prResult.prUrl;` (remote) with artifactUrl = prResult.prUrl and artifactId from parseGitHubPullRequestUrl(prResult.prUrl)?.number. When the stored artifactUrl is set and differs (case-insensitive, trailing slash ignored), rewrite the row via withRepoArtifactUrl + upsertMergeSet and log `[merge] replacing stale stored artifact <old> with <new> for <issue>`. New test modelled on merge-ops-clean-direct.test.ts.

narrative.Action: PRD work item 6 and decisions D7/D8/D9. Add 'review.verdict-deferred' and 'review.verdict-replay-gave-up' to the journal type union. In done.ts, for role review compute caller (verdictCallerFromEnv) BEFORE discoverArtifact and refuse a non-review-session agent immediately through the existing refusal path. Wrap discoverArtifact in try/catch: print `Couldn't reach <forge> to find the review artifact for <branch>: <reason>` and exit 1; for role review with isTransientForgeError(reason), append review.verdict-deferred {status, runId (options.runId or review parent reviewRunId), notes capped at 100000 BYTES (Buffer.byteLength, truncated on a character boundary) with suffix, callerId, reason} and print that the verdict is saved and deacon-lite will retry. Apply the same deferral when postReviewVerdict returns posted:false with a transient reason. True null keeps the existing 'No open review artifact' message.

metadata.parallelSafeReason: Touches only the new cloister/deferred-verdict-replay.ts, one branch in deacon-lite.ts recoverStalledReviews and their tests; no other item edits these files, so it can run in its own slot once specialists-done-honest-error lands.

narrative.Action: PRD work item 7 and decision D10/D11/D12 plus the implementation checkpoint. New module src/lib/cloister/deferred-verdict-replay.ts exporting replayDeferredReviewVerdict(issueId, workspacePath, entry, now, deps?) with injectable execFile/getAgentState. Rules: wait until the tail entry is >= 10 min old; in-flight Set guards overlapping ticks; runId differing from the review parent's reviewRunId journals review.verdict-replay-gave-up {reason:'superseded'}; >= 7 deferred entries for the run journals gave-up {reason:'cap'} plus one warn activity entry; otherwise execFile('pan', ['admin','specialists','done','review', issueId, '--status', status, '--run-id', runId, '--notes', notes]) with timeout 5 min and env OVERDECK_AGENT_ID=callerId (or OVERDECK_AGENT_ID/OVERDECK_ISSUE_ID/OVERDECK_SESSION_TYPE deleted for an operator entry); a non-zero exit with no new deferred entry journals gave-up {reason:'failed'}. In recoverStalledReviews, after the review.halted branch, route a review.verdict-deferred tail to the replay, holding while the issue is paused. Checkpoint: confirm readAncestorAgentIds() is empty in the deacon child (grep OVERDECK_AGENT_ID in /proc/<deacon-pid>/environ) and record the result in the commit body; if not empty the replay is refused, never a bypass.
